subject: POC runway smoothing and conditional discount structure — LumenHealth
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Morris <sarah.morris@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC runway smoothing and conditional discount structure — LumenHealth

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation and I appreciate how practical your team is being about validation paths. Per our discussion, I sketched two ways to make the remaining time-boxed POC less risky for you while keeping commercial momentum:

- Short extension + credits: 14 extra days to complete the last two integration milestones; unused days convert to service credits that apply to first month post-contract.
- Phased usage buckets: allow you to run higher throughput for a 2-week ramp (charged at discounted bucket rates) then auto-fall back to normal POC rates.

Attached is a short PDF with the two options and a redline-friendly addendum template (POC-pricing-options-v2.pdf). Key constraints from our side: we can only grant the additional extension once per trial and the credit conversion requires a signed conversion LOI before we issue credits.

If either path looks workable I can loop in Kimberly for pricing approval and send a draft addendum for procurement. Would Thursday 11/12 at 10am PT for a quick sync work for you?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC-pricing-options-v2.pdf (presentation/pdf)

From: Sarah Morris <sarah.morris@lumenhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC runway smoothing and conditional discount structure — LumenHealth

Naomi — thanks for sending this over. Quick clarifications from our side:

1) We can sign an LOI to convert unused days to credits, but procurement needs an invoice line for the 14-day extension (they'll treat credits separately).
2) The team will need the ability to burst up to 3x throughput for a 7–10 day window during that extension; charges for the burst must be predictable.
3) Any discount we accept requires legal to see the addendum.

We can do Thu 11/12 at 10am PT. I looped procurement on copy (procurement@lumenhealth.com) so they see the ask ahead.

—Sarah
Director, Digital Platforms
LumenHealth

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC runway smoothing and conditional discount structure — LumenHealth

Adding pricing details based on Sarah's asks. Summary (internal):

- Extension invoice: we can issue a one-line invoice for a 14-day extension at $12,500. That satisfies procurement's need for a chargeable item.
- Burst window: implement as "phased usage bucket" — add a temporary high-throughput bucket (up to 3x) for 10 days. Bucket pricing = base POC rate * 0.6 (40% discount) for the burst window.
- Credit conversion: unused extension days converted to a $/day credit applied to month-1 after conversion LOI is signed. Credits expire 90 days after conversion.
- Preconditions: discount requires an engineering success checkpoint (integration tests green) and a conversion LOI signed during the extension.

If we give this, recommend offering the 40% burst discount with the $12.5k invoice path. Vivek — any objections on capacity/ops side?

Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Morris <sarah.morris@lumenhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC runway smoothing and conditional discount structure — LumenHealth

Thanks Kimberly and Naomi — that structure looks reasonable. A few procurement items before we sign:

- Can you send a pro-forma invoice for the $12,500 extension charge addressed to LumenHealth, Inc? Procurement needs PO terms and an invoice to raise a PO.
- Please provide the addendum Word doc so our legal team can review redlines (we prefer track changes).
- For the burst pricing, we need a short one-page note describing how usage will be measured and what triggers the bucket charges so we can attach it to the PO.

If you can get those three artifacts over today, procurement can push an internal PO and we can sign the LOI next week.

Procurement contact: Mark Ellis <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
